http_idempotency_result.name: http_idempotency_result
http_idempotency_result.value:
("http_idempotency"."status_code" is null and "http_idempotency"."body" is null and "http_idempotency"."headers" is null and "http_idempotency"."completed_at" is null)
    or ("http_idempotency"."status_code" in (200,201,202) and "http_idempotency"."status_code" is not null and "http_idempotency"."body" is not null
      and "http_idempotency"."headers" is not null and "http_idempotency"."completed_at" is not null)

receipt_state.name: receipt_state
receipt_state.value: ("receipts"."status" = 'draft' and "receipts"."posted_at" is null and "receipts"."posted_event_id" is null) or ("receipts"."status" = 'posted' and "receipts"."posted_at" is not null and "receipts"."posted_event_id" is not null)
